description: First fixed-budget SAC study; freeze before validation, no checkpoint/seed selection

normalization.behavior: 50% uniform continuous release, 50% clipped exponential average demand
normalization.scope: 42 training years only; fixed mean/std, std floor 1e-6; no replay preloading

evaluation: Final 200k only, deterministic tanh(mean); all 10 validation years; plain and frozen common-filter tracks; test remains reserved
budget_note: 200k interactions per SAC seed versus 1M per frozen PPO seed: exploratory comparison, not a matched-budget algorithm ranking. Add 15330 shared normalization interactions, plus separate smoke/checker interactions. Log update counts and runtime. No promotion of intermediate checkpoints.
